home_title: Patchland: Claim It All — grow your paper realm
home_desc: Patchland is an offline territory game with paper patches, coming soon to iOS and Android. Trace, place and spread to win land from quirky AI lords.
hero_h1: Grow your paper realm,|one patch at a time.
hero_p: Patchland: Claim It All is an offline territory game. Trace, place and spread to win land from quirky AI lords, and watch your color grow across a paper map. Short rounds, no internet needed.
hero_note: Not released yet. Store pages and details will be posted here when they are ready.
games_p: Pick a game on the first screen. The land you win is added to one realm map.
g_trace_p: Leave your land, draw a line and come back home. Everything you circle becomes yours.
g_spread_p: Pick a color and every touching patch of that color joins your land.
g_place_p: Take turns putting a stone on a hex board. Seal off a small group of enemy stones and they turn yours.
g_hockey_p: Cells the puck crosses go to whoever hit it last. Move your mallet and guard your turf.
g_daily_p: One board a day, the same for everyone. Keep your streak going.
more_games: More games are in the works.
